name: OR041.1  Low Supply Alarm Display Requirement
text_en: When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

name: OR041.2  Cooling Water Pump Redundancy Requiremen
text_en: The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

name: OR041.3  Standby Pump Start on Alarm
text_en: When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or changeover to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply.

name: OR041.4  Independent Low Supply Alarm Sensor
text_en: The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be provided independently and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system.

name: OR041.5  Alarm Threshold Configuration Limitation
text_en: The threshold and actuation logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration scope and shall not be generalized beyond that scope.
